title: King of Glory
lyrics: Verse 1:
Who [D5]is this King of Glo[D5(+7)]ry that pursu[D5/G]es me with His love,[D5/AD5/G]
And [D5]haunts me with each hear[D5(+7)]ing of His so[D5/G]ftly spoken words?[D5/A]
My [G2]conscience a reminder of for[Bm7]giveness that I need,
Who [A(4)]is this King of Glory[G2], who offers it to[D5] me?
Verse 2:
Who is this King of angels, oh blessed Prince of Peace,
Revealing things of heaven and all it's mysteries?
My spirit's ever longing for His grace in which to stand,
Who is this King of Glory, Son of God and Son of Man?
Chorus 1:
[D]His name is Je[G]sus, precious Je[Bm7]sus;
Lord Al[A(4)]mighty, King of [G2]my heart,
King of [D5]Glory.
Verse 3:
Who is this King of Glory with strength and majesty,
And wisdom beyond measure, oh gracious King of Kings?
The Lord of earth and heaven, the Creator of all things,
He is the King of Glory, He's everything to me.
Bridge 1:
Lord Al[A(4)]mighty, King of [G2]my heart,
King of [D5]Glory.
